messages.subject: Facing issue while using RHIPE :  because it is missing required fields: rclass
parts:
I m trying the run the test code from the RHipe pdf but somehow i am facing this issue:

rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/x")
rhread("/tmp/x")
map <- expression({
  lapply(seq_along(map.values),function(r){
    x <- runif(map.values[[r]])
    rhcollect(map.keys[[r]],c(n=map.values[[r]],mean=mean(x),sd=sd(x)))
  })
})
## Create a job object
z <- rhmr(map, ofolder="/tmp/test", inout=c('lapply','sequence'),N=10,
          mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=0),jobname='test')
## Submit the job
rhex(z)
## Read the results

res <- rhread('/tmp/test/p*')  
RHIPE: Read 1 pair occupying 214 bytes, deserializing
Error in rhuz(r[[2]]) : 
  PB ERROR[LOGLEVEL_ERROR](google/protobuf/message_lite.cc:123) Can't parse message of type "REXP" because it is missing required fields: rclass

I have tried the option posted in earlies posts but i have had no success, i am relatively new to R and Rhipe and anticipating your help.

Thanks
Hiren Shah.
